summary: Full Quiz (Тесты по лекциям) E2E flow verified end-to-end with the seeded account quiz_qa@test.com / Test1234. The previous-iteration blocker (post-login redirect to /register) is FIXED — login now lands directly on Home with the bottom navigation visible (registration_step=0, GET /api/auth/me confirms group_id=TESTGRP). The new 'Тесты' tab renders, QuizSection mounts, the import modal accepts a Russian lecture, generation against the real deepseek-v4-flash gateway completed in ~30s and produced a valid 6-question MCQ, the player UI works (option lock + green/red + explanation + next/Завершить тест), the results ring renders with a real score (33% on naive 'first-option-always' answering), 'Пройти заново' resets to Q1, close returns to the card list, clicking the card re-opens the player (fetches full quiz), and delete via window.confirm removes the quiz (confirmed visually). One MINOR missing-testid issue fixed during testing: BottomNavigation tab <button> elements had no data-testid — added data-testid={`bottom-nav-${tab.id}`} so the 'Тесты' tab can be selected.

ui_bugs.issue: On every fresh load after login the 'Подтвердите email' modal appears above Home and intercepts clicks on the bottom nav. Functionally fine (dismissable via 'Напомнить позже'), but blocks one-tap navigation for unverified accounts.
ui_bugs.selector: modal with text 'Подтвердите email' / button 'Напомнить позже'

action_items: OPTIONAL (LOW): Consider not showing the email-verify reminder modal on every session start — once per day or after N dismissals is friendlier.

OPTIONAL: Code-review nit from iter-5 still applies — QuizSection.handleCreated uses setTimeout(200ms) to open the player after modal close. Works in practice but is timing-fragile; an effect on a pending-quiz state would be more robust.
critical_code_review_comments: BottomNavigation.jsx: tab <button>s were missing data-testid attributes — added data-testid={`bottom-nav-${tab.id}`} for testability (home/tasks/journal/quiz/music).
QuizSection.jsx: setTimeout-based player open after import modal close is fragile (timing-dependent). Acceptable for now, prefer event-driven open in a follow-up.

Email-verify reminder modal renders on top of Home on EVERY load for unverified accounts and intercepts pointer events on the bottom nav until dismissed. Consider rate-limiting it (e.g. once/day) or making it non-modal.
quizAPI.js: client timeout is 120s for generate — matches expectation; observed real generation in ~30s. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all Quiz E2E selectors and flows verified

test_credentials: quiz_qa@test.com / Test1234 (uid 500341037, pseudo_tid 10500341037, registration_step=0, group TESTGRP/ТЕСТ-01).
seed_data_creation: Generated a real quiz 'Фотосинтез — тест' (6 questions) during the test run via deepseek-v4-flash. It was deleted at the end of the run (only the pre-existing 'Фотосинтез' quiz remains, visible in the final screenshot).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quiz feature is fully working. Login→Home→Quiz tab→Import→Generate (real LLM ~30s)→Player→Results→Retry→Close→Card→Delete all pass with the documented data-testids. Note: 'Подтвердите email' reminder modal will appear on each fresh login for this unverified account and must be dismissed (button 'Напомнить позже') BEFORE clicking any bottom-nav tab — it intercepts clicks until then. data-testid='bottom-nav-quiz' (and bottom-nav-home/tasks/journal/music) are now available on the bottom navigation buttons.
rca of the issue: Iter-5 blocker (post-login redirect to /register step 3) was a seed-data bug: users.registration_step had been set to 3, and the SPA's needsOnboarding gate is (registration_step > 0). Main agent reset registration_step=0 in the seed; /api/auth/me now returns registration_step=0 and the SPA correctly lands on Home. The pseudo_tid hypothesis from iter-5 turned out to be a red herring — Home was reachable as soon as registration_step was zeroed.
